story.titleZh: 安东内利美国大奖赛夺杆位 法拉利挑战瓦解
story.summaryZh: F1车手总冠军安东内利在美国大奖赛中获得杆位，而法拉利的挑战在排位赛中瓦解。
story.originalTitle: Antonelli on US GP pole as Ferrari challenge falls apart
detailZh: 一级方程式锦标赛领跑者基米·安东内利在美国大奖赛上击败了马克斯·维斯塔潘，获得了杆位，而作为练习赛领跑者的法拉利车队在排位赛中遭遇挑战瓦解。
安东内利在排位赛进行中表现出色，在Q3中以0.179秒的优势击败维斯塔潘，锁定了本赛季的第七个杆位，同时伊萨克·哈德贾也使得红牛车队有两辆赛车进入前三。
安东内利是三名车手之一，与梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·罗素以及奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的麦克拉伦赛车一起，在Q1中使用中性胎以节省一套软胎用于Q3。（红牛车队也采取了同样的策略，在Q1和Q2中让维斯塔潘和哈德贾使用一套软胎。）
安东内利在Q1中排名第六，然后在Q2中仅以0.080秒之差落后于查尔斯·勒克莱尔驾驶的法拉利赛车，位列Q2第一，并在Q3开始时以1分34.035秒的成绩暂时获得杆位。
他在最后尝试中在第二个弯道领先了超过十分之一的时间，但随后在13号右转弯道的出口处出现了大的修正，这破坏了他的尝试，似乎也为他的对手打开了大门。
但红牛车队未能提高他们的时间——两人实际上因为超车线违规而被取消了最后的、较慢的成绩——而勒克莱尔只提高了不到十分之一，这意味着安东内利保住了杆位。
维斯塔潘在未能击败安东内利时表示，由于在Q1和Q2中都使用了同一套轮胎，"无论什么原因，在Q3的这两套轮胎上，我没有找到良好的平衡"。
哈德贾排名第三，对于在练习中表现不佳的第二位红牛车手来说，这是一个巨大的转变，因为法拉利的运气完全相反。
勒克莱尔甚至在Q2阶段都保持了最快的速度，如果在最终阶段能够复制这个时间，他将获得第二名，但他最终落后了四分之一秒，排在第四位，而他的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿通过提高最后一圈的表现挽救了第五名。
罗素在Q3中比他的杆位队友慢了超过四分之一秒，也许他能够保住第六位是幸运的，因为在最后阶段兰多·诺里斯也超过了他的位置，但他的这一圈因为超出了赛道限制而被取消，这使他降到了第八位，落后于他的麦凯轮车队队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
小红牛车队在将两辆赛车都送入Q3之后，选择不让利亚姆·劳森参加排位赛的最后一部分。这使得阿维德·林德布拉德，他在周日需要服刑五位的发车区罚分，能够获得第九位发车位，并且可能比原本的情况少降一位。
奥迪车队在Q2结束时与对手不同步，试图通过队友加布里埃尔·博特莱托的拖车帮助尼科·胡肯伯格完成比赛，因为他在本周末因为更换发动机部件而面临重罚。
博托莱托甚至在练习结束后报告说'我希望他完成了我用拖车给他做的这个动作，见鬼，那可是一个大动作'，但事实上，胡尔肯伯格在直道上的位置远远落后于他的队友。
他的第二圈没有刷新个人最佳成绩，胡尔肯伯格也没有在第一次尝试上取得进步，他仍然排在第八位，这使得他容易受到小红牛车队和皮埃尔·加斯利的阿尔派的威胁。
三人确实都比他快，胡尔肯伯格随后在12位被淘汰，距离Q3的淘汰线差了十分之一，而博托莱托排在第13位。（但因为有后置发车引擎处罚。）
加斯利似乎再次将阿尔派带入了Q3，但在小红牛双雄在最后几圈落后之前，他一度逼近前十，只比劳森慢了0.032秒，但由于林德布拉德因更换内燃机而受到处罚，加斯利将起步于第10位。
他在Q2比阿尔法罗密欧车队的队友弗朗哥·科拉平托快了六分之七以上，后者排名第14。
费尔南多·阿隆索在所有三次练习赛中都保持在Q2的前16名进步标记内，尽管他在最后尝试那场资格赛时，他的阿斯顿·马丁赛车后部突然起火，但他还是成功晋级Q1。
阿隆索能够继续比赛，尽管他在Q2看起来是16辆车中最慢的，但他因为最后圈数有所提升而得到了回报，当奥利·比尔曼在11号弯出弯时因为轻微的赛道限制违规，他的最后尝试被取消，这使他从第13位降至Q2的最后一名。
埃斯蒂班·奥康在他们的第一次Q1尝试中比哈斯车队的比尔曼更快，但在第二次尝试中没有提升，而且没有足够的时间击败阿隆索的时间，因此他在第17位被淘汰。
这也发生在兰斯·斯特罗尔身上，周五他在阿斯顿·马丁车队队友的后面，但在Q1中最终落后阿隆索超过四分之一秒。
威廉姆斯车队的糟糕周末仍在继续，两辆赛车比出线所需的节奏慢了半秒多。
尽管在最后一圈没有提高成绩，但卡洛斯·塞恩斯在19位中速度更快，而亚历克斯·阿隆在排位赛结束前过早地进行了不必要的操作。
“真是一场狗屁比赛，”他在排位赛第20位后说，因为他在多弯右转的最后一段，即第18弯道滑出赛道，最后部分。"更糟糕的是，我不知道发生了什么。"
不到十分之一秒的差距将两辆凯迪拉克分开了车队排名的最后位置，尽管这一次是塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯比瓦尔特里·博塔斯更快——据周六在奥斯汀的消息，博塔斯尚未确定将在2027年为车队参赛。
11号皮埃尔·加斯利（阿尔派）1分35.080秒（比第10名慢0.022秒）
15号费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）慢0.738秒
17号埃斯特班·奥康（哈斯）1分36.531秒（比第16名慢0.291秒）
detailEn: Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli beat Max Verstappen to pole position for the United States Grand Prix as practice pacesetter Ferrari watched its challenge crumble in qualifying.
Antonelli came good as the qualifying hour went on and beat Verstappen by 0.179s in Q3 to clinch his seventh pole position of the season, while Isack Hadjar made it two Red Bulls in the top three.

Antonelli was one of three drivers - alongside Mercedes team-mate George Russell and the McLaren of Oscar Piastri - to go through Q1 on mediums in order to save an extra set of soft tyres for Q3. (Something Red Bull did too by running Verstappen and Hadjar on one set of softs in Q1 and Q2.)
Having been sixth in Q1, Antonelli then ended Q2 just 0.080s off the Ferrari of Charles Leclerc at the top of the Q2 order, and jumped to provisional pole at the start of Q3 with a 1m34.035s.

He had been more than a tenth up on that time through the second sector on his final attempt, but then had a big correction on the exit of the Turn 13 right-hander that wrecked that attempt and appeared to open the door to his rivals.

But the Red Bulls failed to improve their times - both actually had their final, slower efforts scrubbed off for track-limits offences - and with Leclerc finding less than a tenth, that meant Antonelli held on to pole.
Verstappen said in failing to beat Antonelli that, having come through Q1 and Q2 on the same set of tyres, "for whatever reason on both of those sets [in Q3] I didn't have a good balance".
Third for Hadjar marked a drastic turnaround for the second Red Bull driver after struggling throughout practice, as Ferrari's fortunes went the other way.

Leclerc was fastest even as late on as Q2, and replicating that time in the final session would have netted second place, but he ended up a quarter of a second back in fourth as team-mate Lewis Hamilton salvaged fifth by improving on his final lap.

Russell was more than four tenths away from his polesitting team-mate in Q3 and perhaps fortunate to secure sixth on the grid, as Lando Norris had gone ahead of him too at the end of the session but had his lap deleted for track limits, which dropped him to eighth behind McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri.

Having got both cars through to Q3, Racing Bulls chose not to run Liam Lawson in the final part of qualifying. That allowed Arvid Lindblad, who has a five-place grid penalty to serve on Sunday, to qualify ninth and potentially drop one place less than he otherwise would have done.

Audi ran its drivers out of sync with the opposition at the end of Q2 in a bid to get Nico Hulkenberg through with the assistance of a tow from team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto, carrying a hefty grid penalty this weekend for engine component changes.
Bortoleto even reported after the session "I hope he went through with this tow I gave, f*** it was a big one", but in reality Hulkenberg looked a long way behind his team-mate on the back straight.

His second sector did not yield a personal best time and Hulkenberg failed to improve on his first effort and remained eighth, which left him vulnerable to the Racing Bulls and Alpine of Pierre Gasly.
All three did go faster than him and Hulkenberg was subsequently eliminated in 12th, one tenth away from the Q3 cutoff, with Bortoleto 13th. (But with that back-of-grid engine penalty.)

Gasly appeared to have hauled the Alpine into Q3 once again before late laps from the Racing Bulls duo dropped him out of the top 10, 0.032s away from Lawson's time, though Lindblad's penalty for a change of internal combustion engine means Gasly will start 10th.
He was more than six tenths faster in Q2 than Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto, who was 14th.

Fernando Alonso had been inside the top-16 Q2 progression mark in all three practice sessions and he made good on that by making it out of Q1, despite a fire breaking out at the rear of his Aston Martin as he headed out for his final attempt in that session.

Alonso was able to continue and though he looked the slowest of the 16 cars in Q2 he was rewarded for improving on his final lap when Ollie Bearman had his final effort scrubbed off for a minor track limits breach exiting the Turn 11 hairpin, which dropped him from 13th to the bottom of the Q2 order.

Esteban Ocon had been faster than Haas team-mate Bearman on their first Q1 runs, but did not improve on his second attempt then failed to find enough time to beat Alonso's time and was eliminated in 17th.
That fate also befell Lance Stroll, who'd been on his Aston Martin team-mate's tail on Friday but shipped more than four tenths to Alonso in the end in Q1.
But Williams's miserable weekend continued, with both cars more than half a second off the pace needed to make it out of the session.
Carlos Sainz was the faster of the two in 19th despite failing to improve on his final lap, while Alex Albon rued running unnecessarily early before the end of the session.

"What a ****show," he said after qualifying 20th, as the lap went away from him in the final sector when he slid through Turn 18, the final part of the multi-apex right-hander. "Even worse, I don't know what's going on."

Less than a tenth of a second separated the two Cadillacs at the rear of the order, though it was again Sergio Perez who was faster than Valtteri Bottas - who it emerged on Saturday at Austin is not yet guaranteed to race for the team in 2027.
11 Pierre Gasly (Alpine) 1m35.080s (+0.022s to P10)
15 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +0.738s
17 Esteban Ocon (Haas) 1m36.531s (+0.291s to P16)
keyPointsZh: 安东内利在Q3中以0.179秒的优势击败维斯塔潘，获得赛季第七个杆位。
安东内利、乔治·拉塞尔和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里是三名在Q1中使用中性胎的司机，以节省软胎。
尽管安东内利在Q1中排名第六，但在Q2中仅以0.080秒之差落后于查尔斯·勒克莱尔，最终在Q3中锁定杆位。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli secured his seventh pole position of the season by beating Verstappen by 0.179s in Q3.
Antonelli, George Russell, and Oscar Piastri were the three drivers who went through Q1 on mediums to save an extra set of soft tyres for Q3.
Despite finishing sixth in Q1, Antonelli ended Q2 just 0.080s behind Charles Leclerc, and secured pole position in Q3.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
